charge_port.notes: Kia US: complimentary NACS-to-CCS adapter offered to 2024/2025 EV9 buyers, i.e. CCS port; native NACS starts with the 2026 EV9.
Kia Canada guide (search excerpt): first NACS Kias in Canada are the 2025 EV6 and 2026 EV9; earlier EV9 are CCS1.

supercharger_access.notes: Electrek: EV9 can charge at Tesla Superchargers with the Kia adapter (April 2025).
Kia Canada: adapters sold at Kia dealers for EV9 owners (April 2025); search excerpt.
